1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube.

2. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the polypropylene or acetal polymer is capable of withstanding temperatures of -20°C or lower.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes and monitoring sample data via the embedded MTP; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the racks and test tubes are maintained and handled at -20°C or less during storage and sample retrieval operations.

15. (Original) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a MTP in plastic or comprising heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP.

16. (Original) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP; and reading the MTP.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the polypropylene or acetal polymer is capable of withstanding temperatures of -20°C or lower.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.
